ensemble.name: Multi-Model Ensemble Blend
ensemble.description: Weighted blend of production bottom-up, possession-level RAPM, shot quality fatigue, and style embeddings

variant_bottom_up.name: Production Bottom-Up Rotation BPM
variant_bottom_up.description: Minute-weighted player BPM ratings aggregated over 240-minute active roster rotations

variant_rapm.name: Possession-Level RAPM (ORAPM / DRAPM)
variant_rapm.description: Ridge-regularized adjusted plus-minus fit one row per possession, separating offensive and defensive impact, centered across league

variant_shot_fatigue.name: Shot Quality & Circadian Travel Fatigue
variant_shot_fatigue.description: Bottom-up ratings adjusted for spatial shot-quality regression and travel/circadian rest fatigue

variant_embeddings.name: 16-D Style Latent Embeddings
variant_embeddings.description: Pythagorean expected win probability modulated by 16-D team stylistic similarity matrix
